events.title: Directory listener, not FTP
events.summary: Inbound 835s are a folder drop. Directory / File listener polls input/inbound.
events.rationale: The remit file is already local for the demo. FTP would add a hop that is not part of the payment-integrity story.

events.title: EDI to XML, then fork each ST
events.summary: Stock EDI Transformation plus XPath fork on //Transaction, using Sandbox 835-W1 TableData.
events.rationale: One ISA can carry four claims. Forking ST lets each CLP hit OpenAR on its own. TableData gives named segments on 23R1.

events.title: SQL processor for OpenAR, then XSLT score
events.summary: Database (SQL) processor looks up expected paid. XSLT builds RemitDecision. XML Formatting sits on the Directory transport.
events.rationale: SQL lookup is a processor so the EDI body can be swapped for result XML after identity is already in attributes. Pretty-print belongs on the write, not the listener.
